changelog.change: item_id accepts a second shape: sixteen Crockford base32 symbols.
changelog.why: Ten decimal digits is 33 bits of an address, which collides on a busy day.

changelog.change: Named the day file instead of the flat state/published.csv.
changelog.why: The flat file was split into state/published/YYYY/MM/DD.csv and removed.
Nothing on the read path opened it: load_published maps url_key to published_on.

changelog.change: Initial shape: the address, the day it ran, and the item it ran as.
changelog.why: A freshness window cannot stop a repeat on its own.

description:
One row of `state/published/YYYY/MM/DD.csv`, appended when an item reaches a
committed digest.

It carries no address. `item_id` and `published_on` join to that day's
committed payload, where the address is already published as `source_url` -
see `docs/architecture/sources/freshness.md` for the worked recovery.

published_on.description: The digest date, not the article's own date.
published_on.title: Published On
